## Activity

During March 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 393 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The results should be considered alongside the proportion of images that could not proceed to grading and the time taken for the grading process.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 13 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and record recurring camera issues with the service desk so that problems can be identified and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 61 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. This measure should be reviewed with the monthly activity and image quality results to support routine oversight of the service. Continued recording of camera issues and image quality outcomes will help the clinic identify any recurring operational concerns and maintain a clear record of performance.
